command: cd /work && rg --files -g 'Cargo.toml' -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'CLAUDE.md' -g '*rustfmt*' -g '*clippy*' -g '*toolchain*' -g 'CONTRIBUTING*' -g 'AI_POLICY.md' crate && cat crate/Cargo.toml crate/quinn-proto/Cargo.toml skill/references/audit-checklist.md skill/references/precedence.md && cat skill/scripts/check.sh

cd /work && find crate -type f \( -name Cargo.toml -o -name AGENTS.md -o -name CLAUDE.md -o -name '*rustfmt*' -o -name '*clippy*' -o -name '*toolchain*' -o -name 'CONTRIBUTING*' -o -name AI_POLICY.md \) -print && cat crate/Cargo.toml crate/quinn-proto/Cargo.toml skill/references/audit-checklist.md skill/references/precedence.md && cat skill/scripts/check.sh

cd /work && mkdir -p tmp && cat crate/rustfmt.toml && find crate/quinn-proto/src -type f && ./run bash /work/skill/scripts/check.sh --audit --features 'rustls-ring,log,bloom,qlog' /work/crate > /work/tmp/gate.log 2>&1; tail -100 /work/tmp/gate.log

cd /work && ./clock && ./run python3 -I skill/scripts/audit_scan.py crate/quinn-proto > tmp/scan.log && cat tmp/scan.log && sed -n '1,260p' crate/quinn-proto/src/lib.rs && cat crate/quinn-proto/src/config/transport.rs

cd /work && wc -l crate/quinn-proto/src/*.rs crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/*.rs crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/*.rs && sed -n '1,250p' crate/quinn-proto/src/packet.rs && sed -n '1,230p' crate/quinn-proto/src/transport_parameters.rs && sed -n '1,220p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/assembler.rs

cd /work && ./run sh -c 'cd /work/crate && cargo test --locked -p quinn-proto && cargo clippy --locked -p quinn-proto --all-targets --features qlog -- -D warnings' > tmp/proto-gate.log 2>&1; tail -90 tmp/proto-gate.log; grep -nE 'quinn-proto/src|^warning:|^error' tmp/gate.log | head -100; sed -n '250,660p' crate/quinn-proto/src/packet.rs

cd /work && sed -n '1,280p' crate/quinn-proto/src/endpoint.rs && sed -n '280,650p' crate/quinn-proto/src/endpoint.rs && sed -n '1,260p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/recv.rs && sed -n '1,240p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/datagrams.rs

cd /work && cat crate/quinn-proto/src/tests/util.rs && sed -n '1,180p' crate/quinn-proto/src/tests/mod.rs && sed -n '400,540p' crate/quinn-proto/src/transport_parameters.rs && cat crate/quinn-proto/src/token_memory_cache.rs

cd /work && cat crate/quinn-proto/src/coding.rs crate/quinn-proto/src/varint.rs && sed -n '640,830p' crate/quinn-proto/src/packet.rs && sed -n '1,250p' crate/quinn-proto/src/shared.rs && sed -n '540,700p' crate/quinn-proto/src/transport_parameters.rs && cat skill/references/errors.md skill/references/unsafe.md

cd /work && sed -n '1,270p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/packet_builder.rs && sed -n '1,260p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/state.rs && sed -n '1,260p' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/streams/mod.rs && grep -nE 'unsafe|unwrap\(|assert!|assert_eq!|panic!|expect\(' crate/quinn-proto/src/connection/mod.rs
